Feature Heatmap Split by Risk Group

Source: R/visualizations.R
plot_heatmap.Rd

Draws a pheatmap of a model's features across the stratified patients. Features are selected exactly as in plot_umap: selected_features() for penalised models and top_features() for importance-based models ("blockForest", "flexynesis"), chosen from model.

Usage

plot_heatmap(
  mae,
  x,
  model,
  modality = NULL,
  top_feat = NULL,
  mae_train = NULL,
  features = NULL,
  rho = NULL,
  experiment = NULL,
  assay = 1,
  colors = .risk_colors(),
  annotations = NULL,
  discrete_max = 5,
  heat_colors = (grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3")))(200),
  cap = 3,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  ...
)

Arguments

mae

A MultiAssayExperiment providing the expression matrix (typically the stratified test object).

x

Either the list returned by patient_stratification or its strata data.frame.

model

Character string naming the model whose features are shown.

modality

Character string naming the omics modality. Locates a penalised model's selected features (ignored for "blockForest" / "flexynesis") and, unless experiment is given, selects the assay to draw. Default is NULL: the single per-run integration tag ("early_<omics>") is resolved automatically; pass the tag (or an omic name) explicitly to disambiguate.

top_feat

Integer number of top features. Used only for "blockForest" / "flexynesis". If NULL (default), top_features's own default is used.

mae_train

A MultiAssayExperiment from which to read the model's features. Defaults to mae.

features

Optional character vector of feature names, overriding the automatic retrieval from model.

rho

Numeric. For model = "AFTCoop" only: selects the beta_rho_<rho> feature set. If NULL (default) and only one rho was trained, it is resolved automatically.

experiment

Name or index of the experiment to draw. If NULL (default), the assay matching modality is used, or the single "early_*" integration assay when modality is NULL (joint models).

assay

Assay index or name within experiment. Default is 1.

colors

Named character vector mapping risk groups to annotation colours. Default is c("High risk" = "red", "Low risk" = "deepskyblue").

annotations

Optional character vector of colData(mae) column names to add as extra column annotations alongside Risk (e.g. c("status", "pathologic_stage")). Colours for these are assigned by pheatmap.

discrete_max

Integer. Extra annotation columns are shown as discrete categories unless they are numeric with more than discrete_max distinct values, which stay a continuous gradient. Default is 5.

heat_colors

Character vector of colours for the heatmap body. Default is a navy-white-firebrick ramp of 200 steps.

cap

Numeric. Row z-scores are clipped to [-cap, cap]. Default is 3.

cluster_cols

Logical. If TRUE (default), patients are clustered and their order is left to pheatmap; if FALSE, they are ordered by risk group with a gap marking the split.

cluster_rows

Logical, whether to cluster features. Default is TRUE.

clustering_method

Agglomeration method for row clustering. Default is "ward.D2".

show_rownames, show_colnames

Logical, whether to print feature / sample labels. Defaults are TRUE and FALSE.

fontsize_row

Font size for feature labels. Default is 6.

...

Additional arguments passed to pheatmap.

Value

The pheatmap object (invisibly), drawn as a side effect.

Details

By default the columns (patients) are clustered, so the risk-group split is not imposed: the Risk annotation bar then shows whether the expression-based clusters line up with the risk groups. Set cluster_cols = FALSE to instead order patients by risk group ("High risk" first) with a column gap marking the split. Rows (features) are clustered with Ward's method. Values are row z-scored and winsorised to [-cap, cap] so a few outliers do not wash out the palette. Feature information is read from mae_train (a training artifact); the matrix shown is drawn from mae.

See also

patient_stratification, plot_umap, top_features, selected_features
